goal: Prevent node lockups and crashes when block storage encounters filesystem errors during P2P handling or chain activation
Ensure filesystem failures trigger clean shutdowns instead of being silently swallowed or causing assertion aborts
agreement: General support for fixing failure paths and adding test coverage, but blocked by recent objections
Unaddressed objection: introduces a regression for index functions by ignoring errors (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: missing block directory falsely reports transaction not found under -txindex (w0xlt)
Contested objection: folding exceptions into nullptr loses context and widens a nullable contract (josibake)
Contested objection: leaves inconsistent handling of rare filesystem exceptions across execution paths (maflcko)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes crash and silent-drop bugs during peer message handling when disk reads fail
Addresses rare underlying filesystem failure scenarios rather than typical protocol operation

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it keeps the node from getting silently stuck when block storage fails during chain activation
Ensures clean shutdown instead of bypassing fatal error handling and getting swallowed by network catch-alls
